faqItems.q: How do I book a worker?
faqItems.a: Go to Find Workers, open a profile, choose a date and time slot, and confirm your booking.

faqItems.q: Are workers verified on Worker Zone?
faqItems.a: Yes. Listed professionals are verified before they appear for client bookings.

faqItems.q: Can I pay online for appointments?
faqItems.a: Yes, Stripe checkout is integrated for secure online appointment payments.

faqItems.q: Can I update my profile details anytime?
faqItems.a: Yes, the dashboard includes profile sections where you can edit your details anytime.

about.heroLead: Worker Zone is an online platform that makes it easy to find trusted tradespeople for home and onsite jobs. We connect clients with skilled workers through simple booking and clear communication.
about.journeyP1: Finding the right person for repairs, installs, or maintenance can take time and phone tag. Worker Zone exists to make that faster: search by trade, compare profiles, and book a slot in a few clicks.
about.journeyP2: Clients can explore worker profiles, see availability, and book services without hassle. From small fixes to larger projects, we help you reach qualified professionals when you need them.
about.journeyP3: We take trust seriously. Workers on the platform go through verification so clients can book with confidence and know who is coming to the job.
about.visionText: Our vision is to be a trusted digital partner for everyday jobs by making skilled workers easier to find, book, and pay—anytime, anywhere.
about.missionText: Our mission is to improve the booking experience with a smart, reliable system that connects people with the right worker without unnecessary delay.
